dialogues.jp:
「ああ、そうそう、これ、買ってきたよ。適当
　に何冊か」
dialogues.en:
"First, read them all and learn the basics of cookery before
you start cookery."
dialogues.text:
"First, read them all and learn the basics of cookery before
you start cookery."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、これは……あの、料理の本……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes...... I will do so......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes...... I will do so......"

dialogues.jp: 苦笑しつつ、手を振る。
dialogues.en:
She replies distractedly. Her eyes are already glued to the
book covers with pictures of delicious-looking foods.
dialogues.text:
She replies distractedly. Her eyes are already glued to the
book covers with pictures of delicious-looking foods.

dialogues.jp:
「んま、一通り読んで、基本的な部分を覚えて
　からだね。料理するのは」
dialogues.en:
She opens one book and started reading. It seems like she's
already getting into it.
dialogues.text:
She opens one book and started reading. It seems like she's
already getting into it.

dialogues.jp:
どこか上の空の返事。目はすでに美味そうな料
理がでかでかとプリントされた表紙に釘付けだ。
dialogues.en:
(I'm half looking forward to her cookery...... and half
worried......)
dialogues.text:
(I'm half looking forward to her cookery...... and half
worried......)

dialogues.jp: ぱらりとページをめくり、本文に移る。
dialogues.en: I quietly leave the room.
dialogues.text: I quietly leave the room.

dialogues.jp:
さっそく没入しているらしく、頼子さんは俯い
たままだ。
dialogues.en: "Ugh...... I am tired."
dialogues.text: "Ugh...... I am tired."

dialogues.jp: （楽しみなような……不安なような……）
dialogues.en:
I throw my satchel to the floor and jump into my bed. I'm so
sleepy... Maybe it's because I wake up on time these days.
dialogues.text:
I throw my satchel to the floor and jump into my bed. I'm so
sleepy... Maybe it's because I wake up on time these days.

dialogues.jp: 俺はそっと、部屋を出たのだった。
dialogues.en: (I should have a little nap......)
dialogues.text: (I should have a little nap......)

dialogues.jp: 「ぐふう……疲れたっと」
dialogues.en: "But before that......"
dialogues.text: "But before that......"

dialogues.jp:
どさっと鞄を投げ捨て、ベッドに身を投げ出す。
近頃目覚まし通りに起きているせいか、眠い。
dialogues.en: I go to the veranda.
dialogues.text: I go to the veranda.

dialogues.jp: （寝ようかな……）
dialogues.en: "Let's see......"
dialogues.text: "Let's see......"

dialogues.jp: 「と、その前に……」
dialogues.en:
I check how she hung the laundry as if I was a scary husband
who checks the dust on a table.
dialogues.text:
I check how she hung the laundry as if I was a scary husband
who checks the dust on a table.

dialogues.jp: 俺はベランダへと向かう。
dialogues.en: "Oh, she did a good job."
dialogues.text: "Oh, she did a good job."

dialogues.jp: 「どれどれ……」
dialogues.en:
The laundry has no wrinkles and they're tightly fixed by the
pins.
dialogues.text:
The laundry has no wrinkles and they're tightly fixed by the
pins.

dialogues.jp:
薄いホコリに人差し指を擦りつける鬼姑よろし
く、洗濯物をチェックする。
dialogues.en: "Good, good......"
dialogues.text: "Good, good......"

dialogues.jp: 「おお、ちゃんとなっとる」
dialogues.en: I start taking the laundry inside, then......
dialogues.text: I start taking the laundry inside, then......

dialogues.jp:
洗濯物はぴしりと伸ばされ、ベランダの柵や物
干し竿にきっちりと固定されていた。
dialogues.en: "Ug...... What's that......?"
dialogues.text: "Ug...... What's that......?"

dialogues.jp: 「良きかな、良きかな……」
dialogues.en: In a corner where the laundry almost stops me from seeing...
dialogues.text: In a corner where the laundry almost stops me from seeing...

dialogues.jp:
俺はさくさくと洗濯物を取り込み始める。と
──。
dialogues.en:
A corner that's completely blocked from being seen from
outside.
dialogues.text:
A corner that's completely blocked from being seen from
outside.

dialogues.jp: 「う……こ、これは……」
dialogues.en:
The corner's as dark as night, and there are some clothes
hanging there.
dialogues.text:
The corner's as dark as night, and there are some clothes
hanging there.

dialogues.jp: シャツやタオルの陰になった、その一角。
dialogues.en:
I'll tell you exactly what they are. They're panties and a
bra.
dialogues.text:
I'll tell you exactly what they are. They're panties and a
bra.

dialogues.jp:
恐らく、外界からは断絶されているであろう、
その一帯。
dialogues.en: White......
dialogues.text: White......

dialogues.jp:
まるで夜かと見まがうくらい薄暗い中に、それ
は干されていた。
dialogues.en: "No."
dialogues.text: "No."

dialogues.jp: はっきり言おう。女性ものの下着である。
dialogues.en: The panties are so small compared to my trunks.
dialogues.text: The panties are so small compared to my trunks.

dialogues.jp: 白か……。
dialogues.en: "No-no."
dialogues.text: "No-no."

dialogues.jp: 「いや」
dialogues.en:
They give me an impression of cleanliness and they're
probably cotton.
dialogues.text:
They give me an impression of cleanliness and they're
probably cotton.

dialogues.jp: トランクスに比べると、小さいよな……。
dialogues.en: "NO! What am I thinking?"
dialogues.text: "NO! What am I thinking?"

dialogues.jp: 「いやいや」
dialogues.en:
I shake my head. Why do I have to feel like I am a lingerie
thief at my own veranda?
dialogues.text:
I shake my head. Why do I have to feel like I am a lingerie
thief at my own veranda?

dialogues.jp: 清潔感のある木綿か……。
dialogues.en: ...Anyway, I'm relieved that they're hid from outside.
dialogues.text: ...Anyway, I'm relieved that they're hid from outside.

dialogues.jp: 「違うっ。物に対する感想はどうでもいいんだ」
dialogues.en: "But...... what should I do with them?"
dialogues.text: "But...... what should I do with them?"

dialogues.jp:
ぶるぶると首を振る。どうして自宅のベランダ
で、下着泥棒の気分を味わわにゃならんのだ。
dialogues.en: It wouldn't be a problem if we were 60 years old.
dialogues.text: It wouldn't be a problem if we were 60 years old.

dialogues.jp: ……とりあえず、外から隠れていて良かった。
「しかし……扱いに困るよな、実際」
dialogues.en:
"......I should take them in and leave them naturally with
the other laundry."
dialogues.text:
"......I should take them in and leave them naturally with
the other laundry."

dialogues.jp:
二人が、波平さんや舟さんのように、枯れきっ
ているのならいいのだが……。
dialogues.en:
I remember Nemu used to be really mad when I went to the
veranda.
dialogues.text:
I remember Nemu used to be really mad when I went to the
veranda.

dialogues.en: That's right.
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.jp: 「……さりげに、洗濯物の中に混ぜておくか」
dialogues.en:
"But...... does she have other pairs? Not only her
underwear, but what about her maid costume......?"
dialogues.text:
"But...... does she have other pairs? Not only her
underwear, but what about her maid costume......?"

dialogues.jp:
そういや音夢も、ベランダに近づくと、妙に怒っ
た時があったもんなあ……。
納得。
dialogues.en: "Well, that's not my problem."
dialogues.text: "Well, that's not my problem."

dialogues.jp:
「しかし、代えとかはどうしてるんだろうな？
　下着に限らず、メイド服も……」
dialogues.en: That's right.
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.jp: ◆料理の本◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんの為に料理の本を買ってきた。
dialogues.en: I put a brown paper bag on the table.
dialogues.text: I put a brown paper bag on the table.

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんの手料理……。
dialogues.en: "Ah, are these...... cookery books......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, are these...... cookery books......?"

dialogues.jp: 楽しみなような不安なような。
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, I stopped by a book store on the way back from
school."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, I stopped by a book store on the way back from
school."

dialogues.jp: そういえば洗濯物はどうだろう？
dialogues.en: "Ah...... May I open it......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah...... May I open it......?"

dialogues.jp:
そう思いいたってベランダに向かうと、きちん
と干されていた。
dialogues.en: "You don't have to ask."
dialogues.text: "You don't have to ask."

dialogues.jp: 俺は安心して洗濯物を取り込んだのだった。
dialogues.en: I smile and wave my hand to the sides.
dialogues.text: I smile and wave my hand to the sides.
